explanation: Accepted the offline YouTube content-acquisition v2 contract and its deterministic evidence. Metadata capability mapping, Thai/English-only transcript normalization, comments/replies normalization, cross-content semantic boundaries, Acquisition Pattern v2, and the storage-neutral KU2D-to-KU2A Dataset Intake contract are accepted at contract level only. This review does not claim live proof for captions or comments. The proposed smallest next step is a separately governed non-production Q-Diving live pilot, so explicit human authority is required before any YouTube API/content request, caption download, OAuth/owner flow, or comment acquisition. Transcript content must remain restricted to Thai and English only.
